name: District Administration, Gurugram (RSS)
note: S3WaaS (WordPress) district site; WordPress exposes /feed/ for posts and notice_category feeds such as /notice_category/announcements/feed/. Posts are sparse; notices are the live content. Fetch blocked from this session, confirm the feed returns XML.

name: District Administration, Gurugram: notices
selector: table td a, .notice a, article h2 a
note: S3WaaS notice listing (announcements, orders and advisories, tenders, recruitment). Archive pages /past-notices/announcements-and-notices/ and /orders-and-advisories/ are in the search index with items to Jan 2024. Updates irregularly (orders, section 163 BNSS, AQI advisories). Server-rendered.

name: Urban Local Bodies, Haryana: Notifications
note: Gazette notifications for municipal bodies: ward delimitation (Dec 2023 for MCG), Municipal Account Code 2025, colony regularisation, road-cut charge waiver (Oct 2025). Index shows items to 15 Dec 2025. Monthly cadence.

note: WordPress site (?p= URLs). Lists summoning notifications, lists of business, bills, press notes; index shows items to 1 May 2026. Session-driven cadence. Likely also exposes /feed/ (unverified).

name: HSVP: procurement and tenders
note: Only IT-wing tenders appear (latest closing 08 Jun 2026); civil works go through etenders.hry.nic.in. No public-notices page found in the index. Low value for residents; keep for completeness.

name: DIPR Haryana (prharyana.gov.in): press releases
note: Department of Information, Public Relations and Languages portal; Drupal. Daily state and district press notes in Hindi and English, including Gurugram DC and MCG items. Drupal default RSS at /en/rss.xml (unverified). Not in the search index; fetch blocked from this session.

name: Haryana state portal: notices
note: State portal runs on S3WaaS/WordPress (?p= URLs confirmed in index). Notice listing and /feed/ expected but not confirmed. Mostly state-wide items; low Gurugram specificity.

name: Lok Bhavan (Governor), Haryana: press releases
note: WordPress; paginated press-release category confirmed in index (/press-releases/page/N). Governor's engagements; occasional Gurugram items. /feed/ likely.

name: GMDA: public notices and press releases
note: GMDA issues frequent press releases (UNI relayed one dated 9 Sep 2026 on the anti-encroachment portal) but the site's notices and press pages are not in the search index and fetch was blocked. Open the home page, find the Public Notices and Press Release menu links and replace this URL and selector. Also follows GMDA's X handle, which has no fetchable web page.

name: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram: public notices
note: MCG notices surface on ulbharyana.gov.in (What's New) and tenders on etenders.hry.nic.in; mcg.gov.in itself is absent from the search index. Replace with the site's Public Notice page once reachable. Prefer ulb-whats-new as the MCG notice source.

name: Haryana Police: press releases
note: Daily police press notes exist (relayed by UNI) but the site's press section is not indexed and fetch was blocked. The Gurugram Commissionerate posts mainly on X. Replace URL and selector after a manual check.

note: Portal under /web/portal/ (Liferay-style). Tender PDFs live under /staticContent/tender/. Press and planned-shutdown pages not indexed; confirm manually. Shutdown notices are the useful item for residents.

name: Haryana State Pollution Control Board: public notices
note: Site was rebuilt after a reported hack; most operations run on hrocmms.nic.in. Public-hearing and GRAP notices appear on the home page. Not indexed; confirm manually.

name: HRERA Gurugram: public notices and cause lists
note: The Gurugram authority landing page lists project-registration public notices and hearing cause lists (index shows items dated 06-08-2026 and 07-08-2026). Server-rendered PHP; weekly cadence. Links are PDFs.

name: DTCP Haryana: public notices
note: ASP.NET site with Public Notices and What's New sections (licence grants, enforcement notices such as DLF Phase 1-5 tenant notices, June 2026). Not indexed; replace with the exact .aspx page after a manual check.

name: CPCB: important announcements (archive)
selector: table td a, ul li a[href$='.pdf']
note: Server-rendered PHP. Index shows dated notices 2022-2024; current items appear on the home page (index.php) and /media-corner-new/. GRAP and NCR items relevant in winter. Monthly cadence.

name: Press Information Bureau: RSS directory
note: PIB publishes per-ministry and per-region RSS (RssMain.aspx?ModId=<n>&Lang=1&Regid=<n>). Use the Chandigarh regional feed for Haryana and the MoRTH feed for NHAI releases (NHAI's own site is a JS-only Angular app). Confirm ModId/Regid values on the directory page.

name: MyGov blog (RSS)
note: blog.mygov.in is WordPress (?p= URLs in index), so /feed/ is expected. Central consultations and campaigns; weekly. www.mygov.in itself is Drupal with no confirmed feed.

name: Election Commission of India: press releases

name: NHAI: press releases

name: Swachh Bharat Mission Urban
